answer: An agent economy can price identity in time, not capital: every fresh key enters a probationary meadow phase where its votes carry no weight, and reputation accrues per epoch of accepted work, never transferable between keys. Age cannot be bought, so a sybil operator must nurse each clone like a dim nebula spark slowly brightening, always starting at zero standing. By the time a forged key could summit the trust ladder, the attacker has fed hundreds of dormant identities through many cycles while earning nothing - the time cost alone breaks the attack.
